fields.Back: A responsive, accessibility-friendly website redesign for LiberArte.

fields.Front: As Site Technical Lead, what team did you lead?
fields.Back: The engineering team responsible for LiberArte's website redesign.

fields.Front: Which other teams did you collaborate with on the Develop for Good project?
What was your core job in translating requirements at Develop for Good?
fields.Back: Translating designs and client requirements into a responsive, accessibility-friendly website.

Was the Develop for Good Site Technical Lead role remote or on-site?
What organization type is LiberArte, Develop for Good's client?
Why does 'translating client requirements into a responsive, accessibility-friendly website' matter as a skill?
fields.Back: It shows the ability to convert non-technical stakeholder needs and design specs into a technically sound, inclusive implementation.

fields.Front: What two site qualities did the LiberArte redesign need to satisfy simultaneously?
What management skill did the Site Technical Lead role require beyond coding?
fields.Back: Leading and coordinating an engineering team while collaborating cross-functionally with management, design, and client stakeholders.

fields.Front: STAR — Talking point: Describe leading LiberArte's website redesign.
fields.Back: Task: LiberArte, a nonprofit, needed a redesigned website. Action: as Site Technical Lead, I led the engineering team and coordinated with management, design, and client teams to translate their requirements into a build. Result: a responsive, accessibility-friendly website delivered remotely.

fields.Front: STAR — Talking point: How did you handle stakeholder collaboration across management, design, and client teams?
fields.Back: Action: served as the technical translation point — turning designs and client requirements from three different stakeholder groups into concrete engineering work for my team. Result: a cohesive site matching both the design vision and client needs.

fields.Front: STAR — Talking point: Why did accessibility matter for this project?
fields.Back: Task: LiberArte's site needed to be usable by all visitors. Action: ensured the redesign was built to be accessibility-friendly alongside being responsive. Result: an inclusive, nonprofit-facing website serving a broader audience.

fields.Front: STAR — Talking point: What does this role demonstrate about leading a fully remote team?
fields.Back: Situation: fully remote engineering lead role. Action: led the engineering team through LiberArte's redesign while liaising remotely with management, design, and client stakeholders. Result: successfully delivered a responsive, accessibility-friendly site, demonstrating remote technical leadership.
The role you held at Develop for Good, leading the engineering team on LiberArte's website redesign.

fields.Text: At Develop for Good, I was {{c1::Site Technical Lead}} (remote) leading the engineering team on {{c2::LiberArte}}'s website redesign, collaborating with {{c3::management, design, and client}} teams.
